item.title: Fixture: Laboratory tests of Irkutsk contacts negative for plague
item.description: The regional health authority said PCR tests of all remaining contacts of the deceased laboratory worker from the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute were negative for Yersinia pestis. The cause of the worker's pneumonia remains undetermined.

item.title: Fixture: Second suspected case reported at Shelekhov hospital
item.description: Regional media reported that a nurse at the Shelekhov district hospital was hospitalised with fever and is being tested. Authorities have not confirmed any infection.

item.title: Fixture: В Иркутске продлили карантин для контактных лиц
item.description: Карантин для контактных лиц в Иркутске продлён ещё на семь дней, сообщил Роспотребнадзор.

item.title: Fixture: Kazakhstan investigates suspected case in traveller from Irkutsk
item.description: Health officials in Kazakhstan are testing a traveller who recently visited Irkutsk and developed pneumonia. No link to the Irkutsk investigation has been established.

item.title: Fixture: Plague concerns grow across Siberia
item.description: Commentators discuss plague preparedness in Siberia after recent reports.

item.title: Fixture: Plague case confirmed in Madagascar
item.description: Madagascar's health ministry confirmed a case of bubonic plague in the central highlands.

item.title: Fixture: Irkutsk airport reopens after heavy snowfall
item.description: Flights resumed at Irkutsk airport on Thursday.
